note: This data reflects laws as written, not how they are enforced. It covers the laws that apply to a woman living in the country’s main business city, so laws elsewhere in the country may differ. Where different groups of women follow different religious or family laws, it covers the largest group.
title: Does the law punish sexual harassment at work, or let victims claim compensation?
subtitle: “Yes” means sexual harassment at work can be punished with fines or prison, or victims can claim compensation, even if they have lost their job.

display.name: Criminal sanctions or compensation for sexual harassment in employment
